brand.name: Time Swap
brand.tagline: give an hour, get an hour

metadata.title: Time Swap · give an hour, get an hour
metadata.description: See what people in your city are offering before you sign up. It is paid in hours, not in money.

balance.label: Your balance
balance.canReceiveFirstTime: You can receive up to {hours} before giving any.

pending.title: Your turn
pending.emptyDay: Nothing for this day. Anything without a date shows up here as soon as it arrives.

upToDate.title: Nothing waiting for you
upToDate.body: We'll let you know here as soon as someone writes or replies.

dispute.label: Open dispute
dispute.title: {listing} with {name}
dispute.detail: No hours move until it is resolved. Add your side before {day}.

contactRequest.label: Contact request
contactRequest.title: {name} wants to talk to you
contactRequest.detail: About “{listing}”. Expires on {day}. Declining needs no explanation.

superseded.title: {name} just changed the proposal
superseded.body: Now: {now} (was {before}). The version you were about to accept is no longer valid.

detail.received: You received {hours}. No hours move without your confirmation.
detail.gave: You gave {hours}. No hours move without your confirmation.

unverified.title: You haven't verified your email yet
unverified.body: Look for the link we sent to {email}. Until then you can look around, but not write to anyone.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: We're showing what we last loaded, {when}. Replying works again once you're back online.
offline.reason: Offline: you can reply once you're back online.

firstTime.lead: Nothing pending yet. Three steps and people nearby will be able to find you.
firstTime.title: To get started

area.title: Set your rough area
area.body: Without it you can't post or filter nearby. Only the neighbourhood is shown.

publish.title: Post what you can do
publish.body: One offer is enough for people to find you. No prices: 1 hour is 1 hour.

discover.title: See what's going on nearby
discover.body: You can ask for help today, even before you've given any.

browseListings.title: Listings
browseListings.lead: Temporary interface: a sample list. Real search is not here yet.

listingDetail.lead: Temporary interface: a sample detail. Contact does nothing yet.

createAd.title: Post a listing
createAd.lead: Temporary interface: the fields are here, but nothing is saved.

hero.eyebrow: {city} · time is not stored, it circulates
hero.title: What do you need help with this week?
hero.lead: See what people in {city} are offering before you decide to sign up. It is paid in hours, not in money.

howItWorks.title: This is not paid with money.

oneHourOneCredit.description: Every hour you give someone becomes a credit. The skill you bring makes no difference.

debitLimit.description: You can ask for help before giving anything: the account allows up to three hours in the red.

noMoney.description: Credits are neither bought nor sold. Only materials are reimbursed, if there are any.

categories.title: Browse by what you know how to do
categories.intro: The starting categories are still being decided with the community.

profile.notFoundBody: This profile doesn't exist or is no longer available.

dispute.label: The brake
dispute.title: If something goes wrong, the relay stops.
dispute.body: Either side can open a dispute. The hours for that exchange do not move until someone on the team reviews it, and a reversed movement does not disappear: it is offset by another one and both stay on the record.

signUp.title: Writing to someone requires a verified account
signUp.lead: It is the only barrier, and it exists so that nobody receives messages from anonymous profiles.

metadata.title: Sign in · Time Swap
metadata.description: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

form.label: Sign in
form.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

conduct.before: By signing in you accept the community

credentials.title: The email or the password do not match
credentials.body: Check both fields and try again.

tooManyAttempts.title: Too many attempts
tooManyAttempts.body: We have locked access for a while. If you cannot remember the password, ask for a link to change it.

suspended.title: This account is suspended
suspended.body: Someone on the team is reviewing it. We will write to the email you registered with.

unverified.title: You have not verified your email yet
unverified.body: Look for the link we sent you when you registered. Until then you can browse, but not write to anyone.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.body: Sign in again to pick up where you left off. Your hours and agreements are still there.

backendDown.title: The server is unreachable
backendDown.body: The server is currently unavailable. Please contact an administrator or try again later.

panel.title: Someone in your area asked for exactly what you know how to do.
panel.body: Contact requests wait until you answer them. None expires without warning you.

metadata.title: Create account · Time Swap
metadata.description: Create your Time Swap account: a few details and nothing else.

account.title: Let's create your account
account.postalCodeHint: Only to show you exchanges nearby. It is never made public.
account.nicknameHint: This is what the community will see. Your full name is not needed.

password.title: Choose a password
password.lead: Only you know it. Make it long, and do not reuse it anywhere else.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, no spaces, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one symbol.
password.weakTitle: The password does not meet the requirements
password.weakBody: It needs at least 8 characters, no spaces, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol (for example ! @ # $ % & * ?).
password.mismatchBody: Check both fields: they need to be exactly the same.

profile.title: Tell us a bit more
profile.lead: This is not required to have an account. You can fill it in now or leave it for another day.
profile.skillsLegend: Skills: what you know how to do
profile.interestsLegend: Interests: what you would like to receive

mailTaken.title: That email is already registered
mailTaken.body: If it is yours, sign in with it or recover access. If not, use a different email.

invalid.title: Check your details
invalid.body: Some field does not have the expected format. Your name starts with a capital letter and the password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

tooManyAttempts.title: Too many attempts
tooManyAttempts.body: Wait a few minutes before trying again.

backendDown.title: The server is unreachable
backendDown.body: The server is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

metadata.title: Recover access · Time Swap
metadata.description: Ask for a link to change your password.

recoverAccess.title: Recover access
recoverAccess.lead: This screen is not built yet. When it is, we will send a single-use link to the email you registered with.

footer.tagline: Time Swap · a neighbourhood time bank
